diagnostic_definition: M2 runner target is the mean of separate-pass same-device CUDA elapsed intervals bracketing the real runner.run call

evaluation_layout_design.generation_order: after model lock; identity, two raw-load, two padding, two locked-M2 top-predicted, two stratified-random layouts per capture
evaluation_layout_design.unseen_requirement: every nonidentity evaluation map hash must be absent from all calibration manifests and unique across evaluation captures

identity_constraint: completion models use identity-minus-candidate feature differences, zero centering, RMS scaling, and no intercept; identity predicts exactly zero
response_definition: start-level Q = mean over four paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced(identity)-completion_fenced(candidate)
